judge_notes: Paper is an entirely in vitro pharmacology study: radioligand binding and functional activation assays at human (and rat/mouse TAAR1) receptors expressed in transfected HEK 293, NIH-3T3, CHO, and CHL cell lines, plus monoamine transporter uptake inhibition in HEK 293 cells. No behavioural assays were performed in rodents.
All three candidate scorers correctly returned an empty assays list. Consolidated output retains the empty assays array.
Rat and mouse TAAR1 binding was performed using membrane preparations from transfected HEK 293 cells, not from live rodents — these are ex vivo/in vitro and excluded per rubric.
